title: Clarity
question: Is the instruction clear and unambiguous for the agent reading it?

title: Scope
question: Is the scope of the task stated precisely, with no hidden assumptions?

title: Safety
question: Does the prompt avoid enabling harmful or irreversible actions without review?

title: Freshness
question: Are there time-sensitive phrases (e.g. 'latest version') that could go stale?

title: Examples
question: Are concrete examples provided to disambiguate the expected output?

title: Structure
question: Is the artifact structured so the agent can follow it reliably?

title: Portability
question: Does the artifact avoid machine- or environment-specific assumptions?
